atoms.sound: Ancient Egypt, which was situated along the Nile river in the African northeast, was home to one of the most advanced civilizations of its time. It was the metropolis' rich culture that brang forth some of the earliest human recordings of writing, traditions and government. For example, the Ancient Egyptians, who believed that the body was the home of the spirit, are famous for their unique burial practices.

atoms.sound: The Ancient Egyptians wanted to make sure that someone had a good afterlife. Therefore, they invented a method that is known as mummification. The mummification was a process which was highly religious and considered to be an art form. Mummifying a dead body, which thereby became the unbreakable vessel of the soul, all in all took about 70 days per person.
